activationPrerequisites.owner: workflow owners A/E and independent reviewer
activationPrerequisites.requirement: C003-C014, recovery-lifecycle and stability-batch currently have top-level path filters. Do not activate this global context list until every required context is guaranteed to produce an honest eligible result on all covered changes. A workflow omitted by path/branch filtering remains Pending and can block unrelated service/docs PRs. Preserve all mandatory tests/jobs; do not substitute skipped/neutral results, fake no-op successes or old-head evidence.

Independently approve the initial registry digest, protected checker/policy source, separate immutable writer-plan policy commit and plan SHA-256 digest. The plan must name the already-known exact base/head and exactly one writer for every changed path, including deletes and both rename paths. The separate policy commit avoids a self-referential Git SHA cycle; changed registry/checker/plan bytes cannot authorize their own diff.

activationPrerequisites.owner: repository owner and independent human reviewer
activationPrerequisites.requirement: Designate an eligible independent reviewer with required repository access. Current frozen CODEOWNERS names only baraabd for protected paths, while the PR author is baraabd; that author cannot satisfy their own code-owner approval. Enabling require_code_owner_reviews therefore needs an explicitly approved reviewer/policy change before it can be satisfied. Do not rewrite frozen CODEOWNERS or weaken review settings as part of this proposal.

For each PR, recompute the latest-target/head candidate and prove all mandatory and affected gates, including recovery-lifecycle and stability-batch. Require successful exact-source evidence, not cancelled/skipped/missing results. Verify refs did not move, preserve required independent approval, and check the actual resulting target before publishing the next verified wave base.

Confirm runner capacity for all mandatory browser/runtime/image gates. After an authorized administrator applies the approved policy, read back branch protection/rulesets and verify checks/review enforcement on covered and otherwise path-filtered changes. Until this succeeds, status remains prepared-not-applied and main remains observed as unprotected.
